name: Spanish Air Moss
description: Spanish Moss (Tillandsia usneoides) is an epiphytic air plant found draping trees in warm, humid climates. Its silvery-grey, threadlike stems can stretch for meters, forming beardlike masses. Spanish Moss collects water from air and rain, needing little care. Mist regularly, provide bright, indirect light, and good airflow. Ideal for creative decor, it grows moderately and is used for air purification. Thrives outdoors or as an indoor accent.

name: Dischidia
description: Dischidia is a captivating trailing houseplant featuring tiny rounded coin-like leaves cascading gracefully along delicate vines creating stunning hanging displays. This unique epiphytic plant originates from Southeast Asian rainforests naturally growing on trees, making it ideal for hanging baskets, terrariums, or mounted displays. Dischidia improves indoor air quality while adding whimsical charm to any space with its distinctive cascading foliage. Known for easy care requiring minimal maintenullce, it thrives in bright indirect light, high humidity 60-80%, well-draining chunky soil mix, and infrequent watering when soil dries. Growth is moderate, reaching 1-2 feet trailing length within 1-2 years under optimal conditions. Perfect for beginner plant parents seeking low-maintenullce unique trailing plants that tolerate occasional neglect. Popular varieties include Dischidia Million Hearts (tiny heart leaves) and String of Nickels (coin-shaped foliage), both pet-friendly and non-toxic making them safe household choices.

name: African Violet
description: African Violet is a beloved flowering houseplant featuring velvety soft leaves forming compact rosettes crowned with abundant colorful blooms in purple, pink, white, or bi-color combinations year-round. This classic indoor plant originates from East African highlands, thriving indoors with proper care producing continuous blooming cycles. African Violets purify indoor air while bringing cheerful floral beauty to windowsills, shelves, or desktops with their charming petite flowers and fuzzy foliage. Care requires bright indirect light (avoid direct sun burning leaves), consistent moisture using room-temperature water applied to soil (never leaves), moderate humidity 50-60%, and regular balanced fertilizer every 2-3 weeks. Growth is relatively fast, reaching mature blooming size 4-6 inches across within 6-8 months from propagation, blooming continuously with proper care. Perfect for beginners seeking rewarding flowering plants responding well to regular attention. Note: African Violets are pet-friendly and non-toxic, making them safe choices for homes with cats or dogs.

name: Zinnia
description: Zinnia is a vibrant, sun-loving annual flower known for its daisy-like heads in red, orange, pink, and yellow. These fast-growing plants thrive in full sun and well-drained soil. Zinnias attract butterflies, brighten beds or pots, and are perfect for beginners. Deadhead regularly to prolong blooms. Plant after frost; blooms appear in 8-12 weeks. Minimal care needed; drought-tolerant and resilient to heat, making them an easy addition for summer color.

name: Nayanthara
description: Nayanthara (Catharanthus roseus/Periwinkle) is an evergreen, low-growing plant featuring glossy green leaves and five-petaled pink or white flowers. Valued in Ayurveda for anti-cancer and anti-diabetic alkaloids, it's also popular for ground cover. This hardy plant tolerates heat and poor soil, blooming year-round in warm climates. Best grown in full to partial sun with light watering. Fast to moderate grower, making it ideal for low-maintenullce gardens and beginners.

name: Surfinia
description: Surfinia is a famous trailing Petunia, loved for its lush, vibrant blooms that cascade from baskets and containers. It features bell-shaped flowers in various colors and grows quickly in full sun. Deadhead regularly for best results. Water generously and use rich, well-drained soil. Surfinia is weather-resistant, blooms from spring to autumn, and attracts pollinators. Perfect for hanging baskets, window boxes, or groundcover. Easy to maintain and fast to flower (within a month).

name: Thuja
description: Thuja (Arborvitae) is a hardy evergreen conifer, often used for hedges and garden privacy. Its lush foliage forms flat, fan-shaped clusters with aromatic, scale-like leaves and reddish-brown bark. Thuja adapts well to pruning and grows in most soils but prefers sun to part shade. Requires moist, well-drained soil. Slow to moderate growth; can live decades. Drought-tolerant once established and offers year-round green color. Prune for shape in spring or autumn.

name: Kale
description: Kale is a leafy green from the cabbage family, known for its curly or flat blue-green or purple leaves packed with nutrients. Valued as a 'superfood,' kale thrives in full sun or light shade and can tolerate frost, becoming sweeter in cool weather. Water regularly and harvest leaves continuously for months. Grows from seed in 2-3 months, ideal for garden beds and containers. Use in salads, stir-fries, or smoothies for excellent health benefits.
subcategory: Fruiting Plants, Outdoor Plants, Winter Plants

name: Peace Lily
description: Peace Lily (Spathiphyllum) is a popular indoor plant with glossy, dark green leaves and white, sail-like flowers, valued for air-purifying abilities. Thrives in indirect light; avoid direct sun to prevent leaf burn. Keep soil moist but not soggy; mist often for humidity. Blooms throughout the year in warm, humid conditions. Low maintenullce, ideal for homes and offices. Grows moderately—flowers appear within a year from purchase. Non-toxic to air quality but keep from pets.

name: Areca Palm
description: Areca Palm is a graceful, tropical houseplant with feathery, arching fronds and golden stems. Known for filtering toxins from indoor air, this palm prefers bright, indirect light and well-drained soil. Water moderately and fertilize during spring and summer. Grows slowly indoors to about 6-8 feet. Maintain by removing old fronds. Ideal for homes and offices to create a lush, green atmosphere. Needs warmth and avoids cold drafts. Safe for pets and children.

name: Bamboo Palm
description: Bamboo Palm (Chamaedorea seifrizii) is an easy-care, air-purifying houseplant with slender, bamboo-like stems and lush, green fronds. Perfect for low-light spaces, it grows up to 5-7 feet indoors and thrives best in moist, well-drained soil. Water when topsoil dries and mist to ensure humidity. Slow-growing and safe for pets. Ideal for living rooms and offices, adds a tropical touch while improving air quality. Repot every few years for best growth.

name: Money Plant
description: Money Plant (Epipremnum aureum) is a hardy evergreen vine with glossy, heart-shaped leaves, popular for indoor and outdoor use. It climbs via aerial roots and thrives in pots, water, or hanging baskets. Known for purifying air, it's easy for beginners, tolerating neglect, and low light. Keep in indirect or artificial bright light, water when soil feels dry. Grows 2-20m, matures in months, and is believed to bring prosperity and good luck.
subcategory: Indoor Plants, Foliage Plants, Hanging Plants, Creepers & Climbers

name: Snake Plant
description: Snake Plant (Dracaena trifasciata), also known as Mother-in-law’s Tongue, is valued for upright, swordlike leaves with green stripes. Extremely hardy, it thrives in low light, needs infrequent watering, and purifies indoor air. Tolerates dry conditions, perfect for bedrooms and offices. Water only when soil is dry to avoid rot. Slow to moderate grower, taking months to a year to mature. Excellent choice for plant beginners due to minimal care needs.

name: Lucky Bamboo
description: Lucky Bamboo (Dracaena sanderiana) is an elegant indoor plant with slender, jointed green stalks symbolizing luck and prosperity in Feng Shui. Adaptable and easy, it grows well in water or soil and prefers bright, indirect light. Simply change water regularly if grown hydroponically. Keep away from direct sunlight to prevent yellowing. Fast to establish, grows to about 45cm indoors. Safe, fuss-free plant for homes and offices, ideal for new gardeners.

name: Carnation
description: Carnation (Dianthus caryophyllus) is a classic perennial flowering plant renowned for its ruffled, fragrant blooms in vibrant colors including pink, red, white, and yellow, symbolizing love and admiration worldwide. These long-stemmed beauties grow 30-60cm tall featuring slender grey-green foliage and clove-scented flowers blooming from spring through fall. Carnations purify indoor air, make exceptional cut flowers lasting 2-3 weeks in vases, and attract butterflies to gardens naturally. Requires full sun 6-8 hours daily, well-draining soil pH 6-7, regular watering keeping soil moist but not soggy, and deadheading spent blooms for continuous flowering. Plant in spring after frost, grows quickly flowering within 3-4 months from planting, benefits from light pruning to encourage bushiness and prevent legginess. Ideal for beginners seeking low-maintenullce, drought-tolerant perennials perfect for borders, containers, cut flower gardens.

name: Daisy
description: Daisy (Bellis perennis) is a cheerful perennial flower featuring bright white petals surrounding vibrant yellow centers creating classic meadow charm perfect for cottage gardens and naturalizing landscapes. These hardy plants grow 15-30cm tall forming compact rosettes of spoon-shaped leaves with continuous blooms from spring through autumn attracting bees and butterflies abundantly. Daisies possess medicinal properties treating wounds, reducing inflammation, supporting digestion, and easing menstrual discomfort naturally through anti-inflammatory compounds. Thrives in full sun to partial shade, prefers moist well-draining soil enriched with compost, requires regular watering 1-2 inches weekly, and benefits from deadheading for prolonged blooming periods. Germinates in 14-21 days, blooms within 100-130 days from seed sowing, extremely cold-hardy tolerating frost excellently making ideal for temperate climates. Perfect beginner-friendly flower offering year-round interest, minimal maintenullce, self-seeding capability, and beautiful cut flower arrangements for home decoration.

name: Peony
description: Peony (Paeonia) is a spectacular long-lived perennial producing large, fragrant, multi-petaled blooms in stunning shades of pink, white, red, coral creating breathtaking spring garden displays lasting decades. These robust plants grow 60-120cm tall with lush green foliage, massive 10-20cm diameter flowers, and woody stems that can live 50+ years once properly established. Peonies attract beneficial pollinators, make exceptional cut flowers, symbolize prosperity and romance, and require minimal care once mature thriving independently. Plant bare roots in fall 3-5cm deep ensuring eyes face upward, needs full sun 6-8 hours, rich well-draining soil amended with compost, consistent moisture during growing season without waterlogging. Requires cold winter dormancy 60+ days below 7°C for flowering, blooms in late spring 90-120 days after emergence, benefits from support stakes for heavy blooms. Ideal for patient gardeners seeking heirloom perennials with spectacular spring displays, drought tolerance once established, and generational longevity.

name: Tulip
description: Tulip (Tulipa gesneriana) is an iconic spring-blooming bulbous perennial featuring elegant cup-shaped flowers in dazzling rainbow colors including red, yellow, pink, purple, white creating vibrant seasonal displays. These graceful plants grow 20-60cm tall depending on variety, with smooth grey-green leaves and single or double blooms that open dramatically in sunlight closing at night. Tulips make spectacular cut flowers lasting 7-10 days, symbolize perfect love, brighten spring gardens after winter dormancy, and attract early-season pollinators efficiently. Plant bulbs in fall 10-15cm deep with pointed end upward in full sun to partial shade, well-draining fertile soil pH 6-7, water sparingly until shoots emerge then regularly. Requires 6-8 weeks cold stratification below 10°C for blooming, flowers in spring 4-5 weeks after shoots appear, benefits from lifting bulbs after foliage yellows for storage. Perfect for beginners desiring spectacular spring color, container gardening, forced indoor winter blooms, and low-maintenullce seasonal interest.

name: Dianthus
description: Dianthus (Dianthus chinensis/barbatus) is a versatile flowering perennial featuring intensely fragrant, fringed blooms in brilliant pink, red, white, bicolor creating cottage garden charm and delightful spicy-sweet clove fragrance. These compact plants grow 15-45cm tall forming neat mounds of slender blue-green foliage with prolific flowering from spring through fall attracting butterflies and hummingbirds abundantly. Dianthus serves as excellent ground cover preventing soil erosion, offers medicinal benefits for digestion and eye health, requires minimal maintenullce making ideal for busy gardeners. Thrives in full sun 6+ hours daily, well-draining slightly alkaline soil pH 6.5-7.5, moderate watering allowing soil to dry between waterings avoiding overwatering. Blooms within 8-12 weeks from seed or transplant, deadhead regularly for continuous flowering, light trim after main bloom encourages second flush beautifully. Perfect beginner-friendly choice offering fragrant blooms, deer resistance, drought tolerance once established, and excellent performance in borders, rock gardens, containers, edging applications.

name: Madhumalati Dwarf, Rangoon Creeper
description: Madhumalati (Combretum indicum/Rangoon Creeper Dwarf) is a spectacular flowering vine producing fragrant tubular blooms that dramatically change color from white to pink to deep red as they age creating mesmerizing ombre effect. This vigorous climber grows 3-5 meters in dwarf variety featuring glossy green oval leaves and abundant flower clusters blooming profusely during summer monsoon seasons attracting bees and butterflies. Madhumalati purifies air naturally, creates beautiful living screens for privacy, offers traditional medicinal uses, and propagates easily from stem cuttings making garden expansion simple. Requires full sun 6-8 hours for prolific flowering, well-draining fertile soil, regular watering keeping consistently moist, strong trellis support for climbing habit, monthly fertilization during growing season. Plant after monsoon begins or spring, blooms within 4-6 months from planting, benefits from regular pruning for shape control and bushiness promotion. Ideal for beginners seeking fast-growing flowering vines, fragrant garden additions, vertical gardening solutions, tropical climate adaptations, and low-pest-resistance easy-care plants.
